_comment: One entry per MCP server this project wires up. install.sh baseline-installs each key at build time via stage/verify/atomic-swap (staged-install-handshake-atomic-swap.sh install <key>). devcontainer-cli-lifecycle, if installed, owns deciding when a newer, age-eligible version exists and calls `... update <key> <target-version>` on the same script to apply it -- this manifest's minimumReleaseAgeDays field is what that decision reads, not something this Skill's own install.sh consults.
